reading: The sketch lays out an issue-tracker detail page: a flat left sidebar nav with two link groups, a grey breadcrumb, a docs-style article (title, paragraph, pale code block, activity log) in the main column, a right-side metadata panel (status/priority/assignee/labels/cycle/estimate), and a dimmed overlay with a floating "Change status…" dropdown panel on top, all content fully specified by the user's typed notes.
